summary: folder-lint preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, an obfuscated script that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (string-array rotation, mixed constants table, mangled identifiers) whose filename and behavior are unrelated to the package's advertised folder-linting purpose, and it is executed without consent or gating during npm install. package.json declares files: ["lib"], but the tarball additionally ships setup.mjs and math_init.js at the root, outside the declared publish manifest. The combination — alternate-runtime fetch to evade Node-focused inspection, an obfuscated payload executed at install, purpose mismatch with the declared library scope, and blobs shipped outside the declared files whitelist — is the alternate-runtime dropper shape and constitutes install-time execution of opaque code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
